coverage: New seed votes and the raw-refined union increase possible strict coverage. Hard quality selection loses more original coverage than it rescues.
retrieval: Full pool removes the shortlist rule. Its selected subject still has lower task accuracy.
support: Source local purity improves under box-derived labels. Target localization does not benefit from the learned membership weights over geometry-only pooling.
reference: Blinded target identities remain underpowered. No reliable target dual-end recovery is established.
source_supervision: Natural labels derived from source inventory are sparse and weaker than explicit referent identities. Synthetic and natural data are reported separately.
